detail.longDescription:
Side note: the "Report issue" link goes to Github. A few thoughts on this...

🔹 Regardless of your feelings towards Git/Github, does anyone expect the average user to know how to submit an issue?

🔹 For those of us that don't have a Github account, what's our alternative? 

🔹 A FOSS app relying on a capitalist's proprietary dev platform is badly out of alignment with the FOSS ethos, no?

#Mastodon
#Github
